identity.addresses: Oude Turfmarkt 127, 129, 139-149 and Binnengasthuisstraat 46 (BAG verblijfsobjecten of the pand)
identity.what: the Oude Turfmarkt block of the University of Amsterdam between the Allard Pierson and the Grimburgwal: north to south the stone front of the former De Nederlandsche Bank (rijksmonument 5780, W.A. Froger 1865-69, Allard Pierson museum since 1976), three Vingboons houses under one cornice (rm 5781, University of Amsterdam front), the former St. Bernardus gasthuis wing (rm 5782, J.L. Laarman 1882-84) with the 'T GASTHVISHOF gate, and the five canal houses at the Grimburgwal corner (rm 5783-5787)
identity.notThis: the installed allard-pierson model stands on pand 0363100012165686 (Oude Turfmarkt 125 / Turfdraagsterpad), not on this pand; this model covers none of it. The ordinary large recipe for this pand (ordinary-0363100012168172) is shadowed by this model.

partyWallEvidence: North (1-2): the north side adjoins the Allard Pierson pand 0363100012165686 (21.6 m) and the ranges behind it; no street sees it. NE 54 and E 102 face the enclosed Binnengasthuis courtyard: no panorama within 35 m, modelled as plain inferred walls.

fronts.dnb: Oude Turfmarkt, bearing 238-248: pavilion N (door, painted lower storeys, aedicule), wing N (four axes), centre risaliet (three axes, fluted pilasters, balustrades, pediment with relief), wing S (four axes), pavilion S; rustication to 3.1, string course 3.1, upper band 8.2, architrave 13.6, cornice 17.3-18.2, slate slope to 19.6
fronts.uva: Oude Turfmarkt, bearing 235: white plinth 0-2.15 with paired arched cellar lights, nine axes of four window storeys, white entablature 15.3-17.6, slate slope
fronts.bernardus: Oude Turfmarkt, bearing 233: gate bay 0-3.2 ('T GASTHVISHOF portal, tablet, pedimented window), ten axes 3.2-27.6, door at 18.9, carriage gate at 24.9, white speklagen every 0.6 m, bands 5.1 and 9.5, paired round-headed top lights under blind arches, cornice 13.8, slate to 17.1
fronts.houses: Grimburgwal corner, bearing 232: warehouse bell gable, two neck gables, the banded 1884 step gable with fans, the corniced house with balconettes; eaves 13.4-15.2
